summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that it received a commitment from Bank of America for a $50 million credit facility to finance two 2015-built LR2 product tankers, STI Rose and STI Alexis. The facility matures seven years from drawdown, bears interest at SOFR plus 1.20% per annum, and has terms similar to existing credit facilities. Closing is expected in Q2 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation event.
